items.name: The “Not a perfect person” trend
items.what: Creators share an embarrassing habit, awkward mistake, or old routine, using text overlay and acting out the lyric "I'm not a perfect person" as a humorous self-callout or confession.

items.name: The “Weirdly pretty” trend
items.what: Creators compile random, candid, or ordinary camera-roll photos that turned out unexpectedly great, opening with the text overlay "Photos I feel weirdly pretty in".

items.name: The “Oh look” trend
items.what: A couple or duo acts out a skit reacting with dramatic panic to a stressful scenario ("Oh look..."), then instantly switching to complete calm when presented with an easier solution or app alternative.

items.name: The “-A texted me” trend
items.what: Referencing Pretty Little Liars, creators write text overlays exposing a specific secret habit or clever shortcut they use, signing off with "- A" as if someone is watching them.
